{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows and dtypes
print("First few rows:")
print(df.head())

print("\nDtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nSummary of customer_age:")
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().head(10))

print("\nSummary of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))

print("\nSummary of status:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())

print("\nSummary of converted:")
print(df['converted'].value_counts())

print("\nSummary of channel:")
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nSummary of customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']])

# Check for sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check if revenue is indeed string and contains commas
print(f"\nExample of revenue as string: {df['revenue'].iloc[0]}")"}
